about: Tocancipá, Kolumbija (id tocancipa): the circuit on the Bogotá savanna by Tocancipá, 2,600 m above the sea, opened 1982, its long layout (circuit 2: 2.725 km, 14 corners), clockwise as raced (the national federation's rules for the 2,725 m circuit, 2025), one lap (docs/dirkalisca-celine.md, »Novih pet«).
